2 أَتَّبَهَا إِتْبًا , (M, K, [but in the latter the pronoun is masc.,]) and بِإتْبٍ, (M,) or simply أتّبها, (S,) inf. n. تَأْتِيبٌ, (S, K,) He put on her, or clad her with, an إِتْب: (S, M, K:) or أتّبها signifies he put on her, or clad her with, a shift. (AZ, T.) ―
-b2- أُتِّبَ, (M, K,) inf. n. as above, (K,) It (a garment, or piece of cloth,) was made into an اتْب. (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
